title: Minerade!
body:
Bottles in minecraft are boring, so I changed them.


![A Preview of some of the potions variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d06ae019a38e601ae265814aabd17699349702a.png)

This pack turns all bottles to a gatorade inspired texture. (minecraft themed of course)


<details>
<summary>Minerades Future</summary>

The future of this simple reasource pack is bright! (Brighter than my own life!)
Here are my plans:
- 16x16, 32x32, 128x128, 256x256 sizes
- Cleaner textures
- More item textures
- Wider version support
- Brighter and more Vibrant Colors

</details>
